## Features

What the system does. Each feature is proven at the levels it requires.

| Feature | What it does | `faults` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `clients.shared_database` | Go, JS, Ruby, Java and Rust clients insert and work the same jobs in one database, with one leader election. | ❌ |
| `job.insert_tx` | Jobs are inserted in the application's transaction and commit or roll back with it (Transactional enqueueing). | ✅ |
| `job.complete_tx` | JobCompleteTx completes a job in the worker's own transaction (Transactional job completion). | ❌ |
| `job.retry` | Failed jobs retry until max_attempts, then are discarded (Job retries). | ✅ |
| `job.snooze` | A worker snoozes a job to run again later without using up an attempt (Snoozing jobs). | ✅ |
| `job.schedule` | Jobs scheduled for the future run once due (Scheduled jobs). | ✅ |
| `job.cancel` | JobCancel stops a job from running again, and asks a running attempt to stop (Cancelling jobs). | ❌ |
| `queue.pause` | A paused queue stops fetching jobs until it is resumed (Pausing queues). | ✅ |
| `job.unique` | Unique jobs exist at most once per key in the chosen states (Unique jobs). | ✅ |
| `job.periodic` | The leader inserts periodic jobs on a schedule, with run-on-start (Periodic jobs). | ❌ |
| `leader.rescue` | The leader rescues jobs stuck in running after a crash, retrying or discarding them (Reliable workers). | ❌ |

- <a id="inv-cancel.never_reruns"></a>**`cancel.never_reruns`** · safety · delivery — After JobCancel returns, no new attempt of the job starts. ("Cancel a job when it should never run again"; a running job that then errors or snoozes "will be marked as cancelled and will not be attempted again", Cancelling jobs.)
- <a id="inv-complete_tx.effect_iff_completed"></a>**`complete_tx.effect_iff_completed`** · safety · atomicity — A job is completed exactly when its JobCompleteTx effect committed. ("A failed commit discards all other changes so the next rerun starts with a fresh slate", Transactional job completion.)
- <a id="inv-complete_tx.effect_once"></a>**`complete_tx.effect_once`** · safety · delivery — An effect committed with JobCompleteTx happens at most once. ("A successful commit guarantees that the job will never rerun", Transactional job completion.)
- <a id="inv-insert.rollback_never_runs"></a>**`insert.rollback_never_runs`** · safety · atomicity — A job inserted in a transaction that rolls back never runs. (Jobs are "enqueued transactionally and atomically along with other database changes", Reliable workers.)
- <a id="inv-job.never_lost"></a>**`job.never_lost`** · liveness · delivery — A committed job is worked to a final state. ("Once a job is committed to the database, River will not lose track of it and will ensure that it is executed", Reliable workers.)
- <a id="inv-pause.honored"></a>**`pause.honored`** · safety · control — Once a client detects a pause, it fetches nothing from the queue until it is resumed. ("Once a client detects that a queue is paused, it will cease fetching additional jobs for that queue", Pausing queues.) Detection without a notification falls back to a poll every minute (#1582), so the probe allows 65 s.
- <a id="inv-periodic.once_per_period"></a>**`periodic.once_per_period`** · safety · uniqueness — A periodic job that is unique per period is inserted, and its effect committed, at most once per period, even across leader changes. ("a job which is configured to be unique at the hourly level will only enqueue once in that hour no matter how many times it's attempted", Periodic jobs.)
- <a id="inv-retry.discard_only_at_max"></a>**`retry.discard_only_at_max`** · safety · delivery — A failing job is discarded only after its last attempt. ("A stuck job which has not yet reached its max attempts will be scheduled for a retry", RescueStuckJobsAfter.)
- <a id="inv-retry.within_max_attempts"></a>**`retry.within_max_attempts`** · safety · delivery — A job is attempted at most max_attempts times. ("The default limit is 25 total attempts, including the initial run", Job retries.)
- <a id="inv-schedule.never_early"></a>**`schedule.never_early`** · safety · ordering — No attempt is fetched before its scheduled_at. ("The job won't be fetched before its scheduled_at time", Scheduled jobs.)
- <a id="inv-snooze.never_exhausts"></a>**`snooze.never_exhausts`** · safety · delivery — Snoozing never uses up a job's attempts. ("Each time a job is snoozed, its attempt count is decremented by one so that a job can keep snoozing indefinitely without exhausting its maximum attempts", Snoozing jobs.)
- <a id="inv-unique.one_per_key"></a>**`unique.one_per_key`** · safety · uniqueness — Unique jobs exist at most once per key in the chosen states, and a retry that collides with a duplicate is discarded. ("River guarantees that only one exists for a given set of properties"; "River will move the conflicting job to discarded", Unique jobs.)
